summary: West edge is hedge, fence and private driveways; no room to pull off.
reasons: Hedge and fence tight to the lane
Gravel apron is a private property entrance
Homes 20-22 m away at 47 and 132 m

drivers.seclusion: Homes 20 m at 47 m and 22 m at 132 m on the same side; sheds 3-12 m at 197-213 m belong to a private yard.
drivers.access_and_room: Ground beside the lane is a thin strip against hedge or fence; the only gravel is the yard entrance with a ute and trailers, which a van would block.
drivers.traffic: Marked two-lane through road with steady traffic; no parked cars seen.
drivers.convention: No parked campervans or tents seen; vehicles at the gravel apron belong to the property.
